logp.method_description: The LogP value for 1 wasdetermined using the shake-flask method and UV-Vis spectroscopy. The 1-octanol used inthis experiment was pre-saturated with water. A DMSO solution of 1 (10 μL, 10 mM) wasincubated with 1-octanol (495 μL) and H2O (495 μL) in a 1.5 mL tube. The tube was shaken at room temperature for 24 h. The two phases were separated by centrifugation and thecontent of 1 in the water and 1-octanol phases was determined by UV-Vis spectroscopy.
